facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of kinetic energy at CV-3102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on CV-3102 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically dissipating trapped and residual energy. CV-3102 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 23 March 2009 a near hit was recorded on CV-3102 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
